name: line-country-bot-go
description: LINE bot that answers country names with flags and capitals, running on Cloudflare Workers (Go/WebAssembly).

scripts.build: go run github.com/syumai/workers-go/cmd/workers-assets-gen -mode=go && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o ./build/app.wasm ./cmd/worker
